incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT 2367890123 — elevated embeddings 99p latency in us-east-1. paging primary oncall. root cause suspected: KV cache pressure.
Sam Chen: I'm primary, picking this up. switching to bridge in 2m. Priya, can you be secondary?
Priya Patel: Yep I'm on standby. ping me if you want help with customer impact comms.
Sam Chen: quick status: graphs show 99p from 120ms -> 2.4s over last 10m, error rate for embedding requests at 0.6%. Top customers: search-as-a-service and analytics pipelines.
Jorge Alvarez: tagging runbook: https://runbooks.internal/redwood/embeddings-kv-thrash — step 1 is check cache hit ratio + disk io on the hosts.
Sam Chen: running quick checks: `kubectl -n infra exec -it cache-redis-0 -- redis-cli info memory`
Sam Chen: results: cache_used_ratio=0.92, eviction_rate elevated. Also seeing bursty small requests from a single API key.
Maya Lin: which key? I can look up app owner.
Priya Patel: request logs show key `acct-42-prod` spiking at 3k rps. That tenant's background job started a rescan at 13:02 UTC.
Sam Chen: mitigation plan: 1) throttle offending API key at edge, 2) add ephemeral cache replica in cluster, 3) open ticket for long term: shard caching and guardrails.
ops-triage: Created incident ticket INC-7891 in tracker. Linked to alert.
Sam Chen: applying rate limit rule now (pushed to env):
```
POST /config/ratelimit
{
  "api_key": "acct-42-prod",
  "limit": "500rps"
}
```
Sam Chen: rate limit applied, observing tail latency dropping. 99p now 800ms and trending down.
Priya Patel: good. scaling cache: spinning up one replica in us-east-1:
`kubectl -n infra scale statefulset cache-redis --replicas=4`
Jorge Alvarez: warning — scaling helps but might mask root cause. file follow-up to track eviction tuning.
Sam Chen: noted. posting customer impact: two large customers saw degraded embeddings for ~8m, some requests retried and failed ~0.3% of calls. Will draft support note. @Maya can you start a support ticket and include timeline?
Maya Lin: on it, creating support case SUP-5621 and notifying account managers.
Priya Patel: ops-triage — can you capture exact host IDs and metrics and attach to INC-7891?
ops-triage: attached heap and eviction logs, host list, and scaling events to INC-7891.
Sam Chen: handoff plan: I'll stay for 30m to verify stability, then hand primary to Priya. Secondary will be Jorge. Priya — can you do retrospective runbook updates? Add a step to block large background jobs by default.
Priya Patel: will do. Scheduling a short retro: tomorrow 14:00 UTC —calendar invite to oncall@redwood with notes.
Jorge Alvarez: action items I'm taking: 1) shard eviction thresholds proposal, 2) add alerts for single-key RPS spikes. Target PR by EOD Friday.
Sam Chen: final status before handoff: 99p at 210ms, error rate back to baseline 0.02%. Scaling + rate-limit mitigated.
incident-bot: RESOLVED ALERT 2367890123 — triggered alerts auto-resolved by suppression rule after 25m.
Sam Chen: handing off primary -> Priya at 2367890456. Priya, please own monitoring for next 4h.
Priya Patel: taking primary. I'll monitor dashboards and follow up on the ticket actions. Thanks team :thumbsup:
Maya Lin: support case SUP-5621 created and customer comm draft sent to AMs.
Sam Chen: post-handoff follow-ups: INC-7891 created, SUP-5621 created, retro tomorrow 14:00 UTC, runbook edits assigned to Priya, Jorge to draft eviction thresholds PR. I'll log the incident summary in the incident tracker.
Priya Patel: noted. closing thread after handoff.
